CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
August 5, 2026, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

  RULES OF DECORUM - Click Here to View

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minutes approval for July 1, 2026, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider Zoning Code Amendment No. 26-00003
  (ZCA26-00003) to establish Inclusionary Zoning Regulations to
  Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code, Citywide.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-080) has been prepared finding
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division Office on
  the fourth floor of City Hall or electronically by request at
  rbrooks@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to recommend this Code
  Amendment for adoption, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-080;
  2) Adopt the resolution recommending ZCA26-00003 to the City
  Council.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to modify the recommended
  Code Amendment for adoption, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-080;
  2) Adopt the resolution as amended recommending the City Council
  adopt ZCA26-00003.
  Item 6a Documents

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Yvonne Lopez,
  for Special Use Permit No. 26-00012(SUP26-00012) to allow a
  barbershop within 300 feet of a similar establishment and a
  tattoo parlor in a one-story, multiple-tenant commercial
  building on a C-2(General Commercial) zoned property at 1315
  North La Brea Avenue.
  This Item is pulled and will be re-noticed.

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by Jenna Spivey,
  representing 7-Eleven, Inc., for Special Use Permit No. 26-00016
  (SUP26-00016) to allow the off-site sale of distilled spirits
  in an existing one-story, approximately 3,400 square-foot
  commercial building on a C-2 (General Commercial) zoned property
  at 837 South Prairie Avenue.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2026-083) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to  al-
  martell@cityofinglewood.org.
   Preliminary Recommendations:
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to;
  a. Affirm the Categorical Exemption EA-CE-2026-083;
  b. Adopt the resolution approving SUP26-00016.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS it is
  recommended to:
  a. Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions as
  appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or any
  part thereof, it is recommended to:
  a. Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

  d. A public hearing to consider an application by Jason Kho,
  representing Jon & Vinny’s for a Special Use Permit No. 26-00018
  (SUP26-00018) to allow the on-site sale of distilled spirits for
  a proposed restaurant and catering facility on an MU-2 (Mixed
  Use-2) zoned property.
  This item is pulled and will be re-noticed.

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of August 5, 2026, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 2, 2026, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
